name: McCormick & Company, Incorporated

corporate_actions.event: Agreed to combine with Unilever Foods (Knorr, Hellmann's; ex India/Nepal/Portugal) - transaction value ~USD44.8bn; Unilever + its shareholders to own 65% of combined equity (MKC holders 35%), Unilever receives USD15.7bn cash; Brendan Foley to lead; close expected by mid-2027 subject to MKC shareholder vote and regulatory approvals
Increased stake in McCormick de Mexico to controlling interest (consolidated) - recalled

geography.fx_notes: Standalone MKC is Americas-heavy (majority US); EMEA and APAC (incl. China) smaller - exact % not retrieved. Post-deal combined company: ~40% EM, ~25% Europe, ~33% North America (Morningstar, S3).

acquisitions.notes: McCormick de Mexico control step-up; Unilever Foods combination pending (USD15.7bn cash component funded by new debt)

management.senior_turnover_5y: Moderate: CEO Kurzius -> Foley (2023); CFO change 2024
management.succession_notes: Foley to be Chair/President/CEO of combined company

ownership.controlling_holders: None today (historically non-voting/voting share classes MKC.V/MKC); post-close Unilever ~9.9%, Unilever shareholders ~55.1%
ownership.board_independence: Unilever to appoint 4 of 12 directors post-close (S2)
ownership.related_party: Post-close Unilever 9.9% holder and supply/TSA relationships expected

A.rationale: Recurring demand; Flavor Solutions has customer concentration.

evidence: Category leader in US spices; brands Frank's, French's, Cholula (S3)
B.rationale: Strong brand position but volumes soft.

evidence: Scale leader in spices; margin pressure from tariffs/commodities (INFERENCE)
C.rationale: Scale benefits not clearly evidenced vs peers recently.

E.rationale: US-concentrated standalone; deal changes mix entirely.

evidence: Transformational deal with 65% dilution to Unilever side and leverage to 4.0x (S2)
G.rationale: High-risk capital allocation; pro-forma leverage elevated.

evidence: Tariffs on imported spices; commodity exposure (INFERENCE)

sector_specific.price_volume_note: FY2021-FY2025 split not retrieved (data gap); post-deal history non-comparable
sector_specific.private_label_risk: Medium-high: store-brand spices common in US grocery (INFERENCE)
sector_specific.top_customer_note: Walmart is largest customer (~10%+ historically, not re-verified)

gates.notes: G6 A: transaction-dominated - pending combination with Unilever Foods (roughly twice MKC's size) leaves MKC holders with 35% of the combined company; standalone MKC fundamentals will not represent the investment over the 5-year horizon. G1 B: pro-forma net leverage up to 4.0x at close (>3.5x staples threshold) with stated path to ~3.0x in two years.

bull_points: Combined company would be a global flavour/condiments leader with USD600m synergies (S2)
Flavor Solutions volume growth (+1% vol/mix Q3) (S1)
bear_points: Transaction-dominated: MKC holders diluted to 35%; integration of a business ~2x its size (S2)
Consumer volumes declining (Americas -2.5%) with growth all price (S1)
thesis_breakers: Deal closes with leverage >4.0x or synergy target cut
Combined organic growth below 2% in first full year
Deal break with material break costs
